tool_input.command: grep -rn "module_path\|resources_path\|resource_path\|opencode_plugin\|template" $REPO_SLOPGATE/installer/ -l 2>/dev/null; find $REPO_SLOPGATE -path "*/resources/*" -type f | grep -i opencode 2>/dev/null; find $REPO_SLOPGATE -path "*/resources/*open*" -type f 2>/dev/null | head -5; find $REPO_SLOPGATE/resources -type f 2>/dev/null | sort | head -30
